recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No FHIR core source change is needed; adding a direct payment-responsibility element to Encounter would be broader than the approved resolution and inconsistent with the Account.coverage backbone design.

additional_context: FHIR-12658 later refined Account.coverage into a BackboneElement with Account.coverage.coverage and Account.coverage.priority, and the current combined branch already includes the FHIR-12658 reconciliation.
